completion_data.completion_summary: Completed the 4-phase closeout of task 619's research report: re-verified every load-bearing mechanical claim against live source (correcting three instances of a loader.lua/init.lua function-attribution error, and discovering merge_targets.claudemd.section_id has no live consumer at all), closed the Outcome 2 merge_targets sub-field gap and the Outcome 6 native-type-stripping/no-tsconfig.json detection-matrix gap with current (2026) sourced facts, and attested all six required outcomes against real report headings. The full verify-deploy.sh gate set was deferred to the batch-level stage per this dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, since every edit landed under specs/** where no gate/suite can express coverage.

memory_candidates.content: A research report that attributes a function to 'loader.lua' within an Nvim-plugin extension-loader subsystem (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/) should not be trusted without grepping the function's actual definition site. In one report, three separate functions (process_merge_targets, reverse_merge_targets, manager.load) were all mis-attributed to loader.lua when they are actually local functions defined inside init.lua. The subsystem spans manifest.lua/loader.lua/merge.lua/init.lua, and it is easy for a research pass to use 'loader.lua' as informal shorthand for 'the loader subsystem' rather than the literal file -- always verify with a direct grep for the function name before citing a specific file.

A manifest.json field can be declared by convention in every extension in a source store, documented in the dev guide's scaffold template, and yet have zero live code consumers -- discovered for merge_targets.claudemd.section_id, which every one of 20+ extensions declares but which no validator requires and no current load/unload code path reads (the section-marker injection mechanism that would read it, inject_section/remove_section, is dead code superseded by full-file CLAUDE.md regeneration via generate_claudemd()). When auditing a manifest schema's field-to-consumer table, do not assume a field read by the dev guide as 'mandatory' or by convention-universality is therefore read by any live code; trace each field to an actual call site before writing a consumer claim.

For a task whose dispatch file carries a Batch Gate Deferral directive on its final (Verification Tier: full) phase, the UNMAPPABLE CRITERION carve-out applies cleanly when the task's entire edit footprint is confirmable (via git diff --stat across the task's own phase commits) to lie under specs/**: no verify-deploy.sh gate or run-all.sh suite targets specs/** content, so neither --only-gate nor --only SUITE narrowing can express coverage, and the correct scoped discharge is simply the phase's own already-named, scope-capable check (e.g. validate-artifact.sh) rather than attempting a narrowed invocation that cannot actually reach the task's edits.
